notes.title: Ekron Demo Update v0.6.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I've made some updates to the demo while working on the new content. I'm looking forward to posting some screenshots around the new puzzles and islands I'm working on - stay tuned. In the mean time I've made numerous bugfixes and quality of life updates. Here is a short list giving an idea of what's been done:


 Reduced torch and lantern smoke trails in the players face and clouding player view
 Added a number of notes that auto populate your Notes tab so that you can clearly see the things you've accomplished.
 Added a number of quick tutorial-like popups alerting you to user interface, controls, mechanics 
 Added popups reminding users they can skip audio diaries and also listen to later/on-demand
 Added ESC, Tab, and the I key to open menu
 Now sorting Notes and Audio Diaries by most recent first
 Fixing some targeting clumsiness around being able to click books or pick up items easily
 Colliders tuned up to prevent player from jumping up suddenly around tables, sinking in dirt, etc.
 Removed one of the puzzle items due to confusion around the clue
 Added grey particles around lore-based non-story essential items


If you got frustrated and didn't finish the demo why not give it another try or send it to a friend? 

Thanks, Adam
